advancement.solarpunk.biofuel_engine.des: Power a Biofuel Engine with the Biofuel you produced.
advancement.solarpunk.biomass.desc: Gather Biomass to start the biofuel production chain.
advancement.solarpunk.fermentation.desc: Produce Biofuel in a Fermentation Vat.
advancement.solarpunk.fusion_reactor.des: Bring a Fusion Reactor online - the absolute capstone of clean power.
advancement.solarpunk.gasifier.desc: Ignite a Biomass Gasifier and put it to work.
advancement.solarpunk.geyser.desc: Cap a Geyser Vent for passive, round-the-clock geothermal power.
advancement.solarpunk.heat_battery.desc: Fill a Heat Battery with Molten Salt to store thermal energy.
advancement.solarpunk.root.desc: Collect Salt - the foundation of solar thermal energy.
advancement.solarpunk.solar_heater.desc: Craft a Solar Heater to begin concentrating sunlight into Molten Salt.
advancement.solarpunk.solar_tower.desc: Build a Solar Power Tower multiblock and bring it online.
advancement.solarpunk.steam_turbine.desc: Assemble a working Steam Turbine and generate rotational force from steam.
advancement.solarpunk.turbine_casing.des: Craft Turbine Casing - the structural blocks that form the Steam Turbine shell.
advancement.solarpunk.turbine_casing_gla: Craft Turbine Casing Glass to watch the blades spinning inside.
advancement.solarpunk.turbine_flooded.de: Let the condensate tank fill up and shut the turbine down. Pipe out the water next time.
block.solarpunk.andesite_solar_panel.too: 8 RPM with 1024 SU at dawn and dusk, 16 RPM with 4096 SU at noon. _Rain_ drops it to the dawn rate and it stops at _night_.
During the day with a clear sky
Generates _Rotational Force_ from sunlight. Output scales with sun angle and weather.
block.solarpunk.beryllium_reflector_modu: _Fusion Reactor_ blanket module. More Beryllium in the blanket burns fuel faster for more _Steam_.
block.solarpunk.biofilter.tooltip.summar: Draws _Rotational Force_ to absorb _pollution_ from nearby chunks, gradually healing blocks and restoring biomes. Cleans faster at higher speed.
block.solarpunk.biofuel_engine.tooltip.b: Outputs 16 RPM with 8192 SU of stress capacity downward.
block.solarpunk.biofuel_engine.tooltip.s: Burns _Biofuel_ to generate _Rotational Force_. Pipe fuel into any face.
block.solarpunk.biomass_gasifier.tooltip: Outputs 8 RPM with 2048 SU of stress capacity downward.
Burns _Biomass_ to generate _Rotational Force_. Produces _Biochar_ as a byproduct.
block.solarpunk.brass_solar_panel.toolti: 40 FE/t at dawn and dusk, 80 FE/t at noon. _Rain_ drops it to the dawn rate and it stops at _night_.
During the day with a clear sky
Generates _Forge Energy_ from sunlight. Output scales with sun angle and weather.
block.solarpunk.crystallizer.tooltip.beh: Pipe both input fluids in from any face; collect the result from the block or a hopper below, and any byproduct fluid from any face.
block.solarpunk.crystallizer.tooltip.sum: Runs data-driven recipes that turn up to two fluids into an item, plus an optional fluid byproduct. By default, quenches _Molten Salt_ with _Water_ into _Salt_ and some _Steam_ - the fast/bulk counterpart to the Solar Heater's slow evaporation trickle.
block.solarpunk.fermentation_vat.tooltip: Increases batch size and output. A 3x3 footprint processes 9 Biomass per batch. Taller vats produce super-linearly more Biofuel per batch.
Ferments _Biomass_ and water into _Biofuel_. Requires at least a _2x2 footprint_ and _4 blocks tall_ to operate.
block.solarpunk.firebox_boiler.tooltip.b: Converts water to Steam at a fixed rate. Insert fuel by hand or hopper; pipe water in and Steam out of any face.
block.solarpunk.firebox_boiler.tooltip.s: Burns furnace fuel to boil water into _Steam_ for the _Steam Turbine_. A cheap way to get a turbine running before building a Solar Power Tower - nowhere near as efficient at scale.
block.solarpunk.fusion_reactor_core.tool: A _redstone signal_ on any Casing block sets the throttle; no signal means idle. Pipe fuel in and Steam out through any Casing block.
Burns them before _Lithium_, with no breeding waste, and hands back the _Empty Fuel Capsules_. Breeder Modules slowly refill empty capsules left inside.

Heart of the _Fusion Reactor_. Goes at the center of a sphere of _Fusion Reactor Casing_ with rings of _Blanket Modules_ inside, and turns _Deuterium_ and _Lithium Dust_ or _Tritium Capsules_ into _Steam_.
block.solarpunk.geyser_cap.tooltip.behav: Generates 32 RPM with 16384 SU of stress capacity. Works day and night in all weather.
block.solarpunk.geyser_cap.tooltip.condi: When placed on a Geyser Vent
block.solarpunk.geyser_cap.tooltip.summa: Harnesses the energy of a _Geyser Vent_ for passive, round-the-clock _Rotational Force_.
block.solarpunk.heat_battery.tooltip.beh: Heats the boiler above, _superheating_ it while at least a quarter charged. Stored heat slowly fades.
block.solarpunk.heat_battery.tooltip.sum: Stores thermal energy as _Molten Salt_ and supplies heat to a _Boiler_ placed above it.
Charges up while _no Redstone_ signal is applied.
Discharges at 16 RPM with 256 SU of stress capacity until empty.
When connected to a spinning network
When a Redstone signal is applied
Stores _Rotational Force_ for later use. Useful for buffering intermittent generators like solar panels.
block.solarpunk.kinetic_sprinkler.toolti: _Bone meals_ every crop in range each second.
When supplied with Fertilizer instead of water
Pipe in _water_ to hydrate _farmland_ and speed up _crop growth_ in a 5x5 area below it.
block.solarpunk.lithium_breeder_module.t: _Fusion Reactor_ blanket module. More Lithium in the blanket means a lower, steadier output that uses fuel more efficiently.
block.solarpunk.particle_accelerator_inp: Crafts whatever its contents match, if the ring is _wide enough_ and spins _fast enough_. Bigger rings draw more _stress_.
Go in and come back out through the _cap_, the _opposite side_ or the _top_, so you can feed one face and empty another. The _filter slot_ on the cap picks which recipe to make.
The heart of a _Particle Accelerator_. Smashes items together in a _closed ring_ of pipes to make new materials.
block.solarpunk.particle_accelerator_pip: Opens a menu to pick the _shape_ it places.
Turns itself to _connect_ to the pipes around it. A _Wrench_ turns it by hand.
When placed next to the ring
Builds the ring of a _Particle Accelerator_. One pipe places every shape: _straight_, _bends_ and _diagonals_.
block.solarpunk.solar_heater.tooltip.beh: Melts the loaded item and evaporates stored water. Runs at half speed in _rain_ and stops in _thunderstorms_.
block.solarpunk.solar_heater.tooltip.con: During the day with a clear sky
block.solarpunk.solar_heater.tooltip.sum: Uses _sunlight_ to melt items into fluid and passively evaporate water into _Salt_.
block.solarpunk.solar_mirror.tooltip.sum: Place on the ground near a _Solar Power Tower_. Links automatically when it has open sky and a clear line of sight to the tower, then tracks the sun. Too many mirrors lowers the tower's efficiency, down to zero at twice the optimal count.
block.solarpunk.solar_power_tower.toolti: Output grows with tower height and its _Solar Mirror_ field. Efficiency peaks at an optimal mirror count that grows with height, and falls off past it.
At least 3x3 and 3 tall, in clear daylight
Multiblock tower that concentrates reflected sunlight to produce _Molten Salt_ or _Steam_ from water. Right-click with a Wrench to switch modes.
block.solarpunk.turbine_rotor.tooltip.be: Output grows with height and blade quality. Condensed water must be piped out of any casing face, or the turbine stops when it fills up.
block.solarpunk.turbine_rotor.tooltip.su: The core of the _Steam Turbine_ multiblock. Pipe _Steam_ into the casing walls and collect _Rotational Force_ from the cap rotor. Can be built standing up or on its side.
create.solar_punk.tooltip.condensate_ful: Condensate full - drain water to restart

solarpunk.ponder.andesite_panel_usage.te: The Andesite Solar Panel turns sunlight into Rotational Force
At dawn and dusk it gives 8 RPM and 1024 SU of stress capacity...
...and at noon in clear weather, 16 RPM and 4096 SU
Rotation comes out of the bottom
Rain drops it back to dawn levels
At night, or with anything above it blocking the sky, it stops
solarpunk.ponder.biofuel_engine_usage.te: The Biofuel Engine burns Biofuel to make Rotational Force
Pipe Biofuel into any side to fill its tank
While it has fuel it gives 16 RPM and 8192 SU of stress capacity
Rotation comes out of the bottom
A full tank of 8 buckets lasts about 5 minutes
Once the tank runs dry it stops. A Fermentation Vat can keep it supplied
The Biomass Gasifier burns Biomass to make Rotational Force
Feed it Biomass with a Funnel, Hopper or Chute
While burning it gives 8 RPM and 2048 SU of stress capacity
Rotation comes out of the bottom
Biomass Pellets burn twice as long, and leave twice the Biochar
Burnt fuel leaves Biochar behind. Pull it out with a Funnel or Chute, or the Gasifier pauses when it's full
Without fuel it stops. A Kinetic Battery can keep things running between refills
solarpunk.ponder.brass_panel_usage.text_: The Brass Solar Panel turns sunlight straight into Forge Energy (FE)
It makes 40 FE/t at dawn and dusk, and 80 FE/t at noon in clear weather
Connect cables to any side to draw the power. It keeps a buffer, so it can be drained at night
Rain drops it to dawn levels. At night, or with the sky blocked, it stops
solarpunk.ponder.crystallizer_usage.head: Using the Crystallizer
solarpunk.ponder.crystallizer_usage.text: The Crystallizer quenches Molten Salt with Water, turning it back into Salt
Pipe both fluids into any side, or right-click with buckets
It works day or night, and much faster than evaporating water in a Solar Heater
Salt collects inside. Take it by hand, or with a Hopper or Funnel
The quench also flashes off a little Steam - pipe it out to a Steam Turbine
Its recipes come from datapacks, so modpacks can add their own
solarpunk.ponder.fermentation_vat_scalin: A wider vat takes more Biomass per batch, and makes more Biofuel: 4 at a time for 2x2, 9 for 3x3
Building it taller makes each batch give much more Biofuel, and holds more fluid
Vats can go up to 3x3 wide and 16 tall. Goggles show each batch's size and output
Fermentation Vat blocks merge into one big vat. It needs at least a 2x2 footprint and 4 blocks of height
...and feed it Biomass with a Funnel or Hopper
It ferments them together into Biofuel, a batch at a time
Pipe the Biofuel out of any side, to a Biofuel Engine
solarpunk.ponder.fusion_reactor_structur: The Fusion Reactor Core sits at the exact center of a fixed spherical shell - it doesn't grow taller like the Steam Turbine, it's always this one size
Steam comes out of any Casing block - enough for a whole bank of Steam Turbines

Fill the inner ring band with Blanket Modules - it's an open gyroscope skeleton, not a sealed ball, so the Core stays visible through the gaps. Lithium Breeder for efficient fuel use, Beryllium Reflector for raw output, mixed in whatever ratio you want
Enclose the whole shell in Fusion Reactor Casing - swap in Casing Glass anywhere for a clear view straight through to the open Blanket band underneath
Once the shell and blanket band are complete, the reactor lights up - check it with Goggles to see its status and blanket mix
The Core itself disappears once the reactor is fully formed - all that's left floating here is the glowing rings and crackling energy
More Beryllium in the blanket burns fuel faster for more steam output; more Lithium breeds Tritium more efficiently for a lower, steadier output
Pipe Deuterium and feed Lithium Dust into any Casing block. Both come from Basin mixing: Deuterium from heated Water and Copper, Lithium from superheated Water and Salt
Tritium Capsules from a Particle Accelerator burn before Lithium, with no breeding waste. The empty capsules come back out
A Redstone signal on any Casing block sets the throttle - a stronger signal burns more fuel. No signal, no power
solarpunk.ponder.geyser_cap_usage.text_1: Geyser Vents are found naturally in deserts, badlands and savannas
solarpunk.ponder.geyser_cap_usage.text_2: Put a Geyser Cap right on top of one to harness it
solarpunk.ponder.geyser_cap_usage.text_3: It gives a constant 32 RPM and 16384 SU of stress capacity - no fuel, no sunlight, day and night
solarpunk.ponder.geyser_cap_usage.text_4: Rotation comes out of both of its sides
solarpunk.ponder.heat_battery_filling.te: The Heat Battery stores heat from Molten Salt
Pipe Molten Salt into any side, or right-click with a bucket
It slowly turns the salt into stored heat, and starts glowing
Once its heat store is a quarter full, it's Superheated and glows brighter
Goggles show the stored heat, and Comparators read it as a signal
solarpunk.ponder.heat_battery_usage.head: Using the Heat Battery
solarpunk.ponder.heat_battery_usage.text: A hot Heat Battery heats Create's Boilers, just like a Blaze Burner
Put the Boiler's Fluid Tank right on top of it - no fuel needed
Heated runs a Boiler like a lit Blaze Burner, Superheated like one fed a Blaze Cake
Stored heat slowly leaks away, so keep the salt coming from a Solar Heater or Solar Power Tower
When the heat runs out, the Boiler goes cold
solarpunk.ponder.kinetic_battery_usage.t: The Kinetic Battery stores Rotational Force to use later
Connected to a spinning network, it charges up
Goggles show how full it is
Give it a Redstone signal and it lets the power back out along its axis
It runs at a steady 16 RPM with 256 SU, for up to twice as long as it charged
Use it to bridge the gaps in Solar Panels, Gasifiers and other on-and-off power
solarpunk.ponder.particle_accelerator_cr: Power the Accelerator Input with a shaft from below
Items go in through the cap, the opposite side or the top, with Funnels, Belts or Hoppers. Like a Basin, any order works
The filter slot on the cap picks which recipe it makes
Once the contents match a recipe the ring is wide and fast enough for, two beams race around it in opposite directions
They speed up as the recipe goes on...
...and collide in the Input exactly as it finishes. Pull the result out of any of those faces
Bigger rings draw more stress. Goggles on the Input say what's missing: a closed ring, a wider ring, more speed or more stress capacity
solarpunk.ponder.particle_accelerator_ri: A Particle Accelerator is a closed ring of Pipes with one Accelerator Input in it
Every shape comes from the same Pipe item. Hold the Toolbelt key (Alt) while holding Pipes to pick Straight, Bend or Diagonal
Placed next to the ring, a Pipe turns itself to connect. A Wrench turns it by hand
Every turn is 45 degrees: a Bend, Diagonal Pipes, then another Bend make a corner
The ring's diameter is the shorter side of its footprint. Bigger recipes need a wider ring
If the ring isn't a closed loop, the Accelerator won't run
solarpunk.ponder.solar_heater_evaporatio: The Solar Heater can also boil Water down into Salt
Pipe Water into any side, or right-click with a bucket
In daylight, every 250 mB of Water leaves behind one Salt
Take the Salt by hand or with a Hopper or Funnel, then melt it into Molten Salt
It's slow, so once you have Molten Salt, a Crystallizer is a faster way to make more
solarpunk.ponder.solar_heater_usage.head: Using the Solar Heater
solarpunk.ponder.solar_heater_usage.text: The Solar Heater uses sunlight to melt items into fluids
Right-click to put an item in, one at a time - Salt melts into Molten Salt
In daylight it melts one item every 10 seconds. Rain halves that, and at night it stops
It needs open sky right above it, so nothing can go on top
Pipe the fluid out of any side, or take it with a bucket
Stone and Cobblestone melt into Lava. JEI shows everything it can melt
solarpunk.ponder.solar_power_tower_mirro: Solar Mirrors are freestanding - place them on the ground, they don't attach to the tower
A mirror links automatically if it has open sky above it and a clear line of sight to the tower
The search radius scales with the tower's height, and taller towers can track more mirrors at once
Each linked mirror's post turns to face the tower, and its plate tilts to bisect the sun and the tower - tracking the sun all day
Efficiency follows a triangle curve peaking at an optimal mirror count for the field - doubling past that drops it back to zero
Check a linked tower with Goggles to see its mirror count and current efficiency
solarpunk.ponder.solar_power_tower_usage: Stack Solar Power Tower blocks vertically - they merge into a single multiblock
The tower requires at least a 3x3 footprint and 3 blocks tall to produce anything
Pipe water in through any side face to fill the water tank
During the day with a clear sky, the tower converts water into Molten Salt - rain and night stop production
Solar Mirrors placed nearby link to the tower automatically and boost output - see the Solar Mirrors scene for details
Drain the Molten Salt from the output and pipe it to a Heat Battery
Right-click the tower with a Wrench to switch it to Steam mode - the stored fluid is cleared on switch
In Steam mode the tower produces Steam directly - pipe it to a Steam Turbine or other consumer
solarpunk.ponder.tag.bio_machines.descri: Machines for producing and burning Biofuel
solarpunk.ponder.tag.fusion_reactor.desc: Endgame direct-steam fusion power, fed by Deuterium and Lithium
solarpunk.ponder.tag.particle_accelerato: A ring of pipes that smashes items together into new materials
solarpunk.ponder.tag.solar_machines.desc: Machines that harness the power of sunlight
solarpunk.ponder.tag.solar_tower.descrip: Concentrated solar power for producing Molten Salt
solarpunk.ponder.turbine_condensate.head: Steam Condensation
solarpunk.ponder.turbine_condensate.text: As steam drives the rotor it condenses back into water - this condensate collects inside the turbine
Check the condensate water level at any time using Engineer's Goggles on any Rotor block
When the condensate tank is full the turbine shuts down automatically - no more steam is consumed until the water is drained
Pipe the condensate water out of any casing face to drain it - the turbine restarts as soon as there is room
solarpunk.ponder.turbine_horizontal.head: Building On Its Side
solarpunk.ponder.turbine_horizontal.text: The Steam Turbine doesn't have to stand up - the same shell also works lying on the East/West or North/South axis
Place the first Rotor against the face pointing the way you want it to grow - the whole structure follows that axis
It works exactly the same way from there - pipe in Steam, and power exits from the far Rotor
solarpunk.ponder.turbine_max.text_1: The sealed floor is a full 7x7 of Turbine Casing with no rotor - it anchors the structure from below
solarpunk.ponder.turbine_max.text_2: A taller turbine consumes more Steam per tick but produces proportionally more SU - height is the main throughput lever
solarpunk.ponder.turbine_max.text_3: Fill every blade slot with Brass Blades for the best Steam-to-SU efficiency
solarpunk.ponder.turbine_max.text_4: Cap the top identically to the floor - full 7x7 Casing with the Rotor at center. Power exits from the top of this rotor
solarpunk.ponder.turbine_max.text_5: Replace any casing with Turbine Casing Glass anywhere in the structure to see inside - still valid
solarpunk.ponder.turbine_max.text_6: 20 blade layers, all Brass - this is the true maximum, and it can power an entire base
solarpunk.ponder.turbine_structure.text_: Start with a sealed floor - fill the entire 7x7 footprint with Turbine Casing, including the center
Above the floor, build ring-only layers with a Rotor at center and Turbine Blades in the plus pattern
One blade per arm, four arms - four blades total per layer. Andesite is cheaper; Brass is more efficient
Stack as many blade layers as you want - each adds more throughput
Seal the top the same way as the floor - full 7x7 of Turbine Casing with the Rotor at center
Pipe Steam into any face of the outer casing wall - condensate water drains from any casing face too
Rotational power exits from the top face of the cap rotor - connect a shaft directly above
